Main charitable entity types: Private foundation (хувийн сан); Association (нийгмийн эвлэл); NGO under the Law on Associations (1997) + Civil Code (2002)
Est. cost & time: Modest state fees (tens of USD) plus notarization; typically 2–8 weeks for registration.

Main charitable entity types: Private foundation (財團法人); Mutual-benefit association (互益社團法人)
Est. cost & time: Modest registration fees (a few hundred to a few thousand USD with legal help); typically 4–12 weeks once capital is deposited.
Key local requirements: Foreigners can form a private foundation under the Foundations Act (2018) with a local registered office; minimum endowment is set by each competent authority (e.g. Taipei City charity foundations: NT$10M cash; central-level foundations higher); after authority permission, register at the local District Court; documents in Chinese, board can include foreign directors.
Main bottleneck (remote foreign founder): Local office, deposited capital (NT$15m local / NT$30m central), Chinese-language docs and local counsel

Main charitable entity types: Private foundation (Fundação) or association (社團) under Law 2/99/M and the Civil Code provisions on legal persons (arts. 140-172)
Est. cost & time: Notary and registration costs of a few hundred to a few thousand MOP; typically a few weeks to 2–3 months.

Main charitable entity types: Foundation (มูลนิธิ, Civil and Commercial Code ss.110-136; endowment ~THB 200,000-500,000) and registered association (CCC ss.78-109), registered with the Ministry of Interior registrar (district office in Bangkok / Provincial Governor elsewhere).

Main charitable entity types: Registered society under the Societies Act, Chap. 203, with the Registrar of Societies (Royal Brunei Police, Gadong); charitable societies must adopt a constitution per the Act's Second Schedule.

Main charitable entity types: Non-profit associations and foundations under Decree-Law 5/2005; an association gains juridical personality on registration with the Ministry of Justice, effective against third parties after gazette publication.
